datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data on a monthly basis throughout 2013 in Djibouti. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in multiple formats (GeoJSON, KML) with temporal snapshots from January, April, July, and October 2013, representing the current food insecurity situation at each collection date.
